== ./.claude/rules/forge.md
# ws

A workspace.

| Work on | Read |
|---|---|
| Purpose, goal, scope | `.forge/PROJECT.md` |
| Invariants that must never break | `.forge/RULES.md` |
| Options already rejected | `.forge/REJECTED.md` |
| Current work | `forge status` |
| Planned work | `forge status --json` |
| Research, learning, reviews, notes, references | `vault/Index.md` |

| Repo | Read |
|---|---|
| api — The API. | `api/.claude/rules/forge.md` |
| web — The web app. | `web/.claude/rules/forge.md` |

== ./api/.claude/rules/forge.md
# api

The API.

| Work on | Read |
|---|---|
| Components, boundaries, code layout | `.forge/ARCHITECTURE.md` |
| Languages, frameworks, build, run, deploy | `.forge/STACK.md` |
| Code patterns specific to this repo | `.forge/CONVENTIONS.md` |
| Test layout, commands, gates | `.forge/TESTING.md` |
| External services, APIs, secrets | `.forge/INTEGRATIONS.md` |
| Known problems and their status; record a new one with `forge concern add`, never by editing `CONCERNS.md`, which `forge map` and every concern command regenerate from `concerns.json` | `.forge/CONCERNS.md` |
| Invariants that must never break | `.forge/RULES.md` |
| Options already rejected | `.forge/REJECTED.md` |

| External services, APIs, secrets | `.forge/INTEGRATIONS.md` |
| Known problems and their status; record a new one with `forge concern add`, never by editing `CONCERNS.md`, which `forge map` and every concern command regenerate from `concerns.json` | `.forge/CONCERNS.md` |
